selected.title: fix(browser): reject invalid UTF-8 in HTTP CDP discovery
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Reject malformed UTF-8 before CDP discovery decodes JSON, preserving target titles and URLs.
selected.summary_zh: 在 CDP 发现阶段先校验 UTF-8，避免因损坏字节被静默替换而改变目标标题和 URL。
selected.technical_value: Protocol input integrity; complete-body validation, split multibyte input and recovery regressions.
selected.limitations: Ordinary validation correction, not a new security capability or performance claim. Loopback tests do not establish real-browser qualification.

selected.title: fix: preserve exclusive face crop boundaries
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Align face-region bounds and anti-spoofing ROIs with exclusive image-crop coordinates.
selected.summary_zh: 统一人脸裁剪、返回区域与活体检测 ROI 的右/下边界，修复末端像素丢失和零宽高报告。
selected.technical_value: Cross-path geometry contract, singleton/full-frame cases and anti-spoof ROI regression coverage.
selected.limitations: No recognition-accuracy or anti-spoofing-quality improvement claim; broad optional model/backend suite was not run.

selected.title: fix(vla_jepa): pair rotary frequencies with adjacent coordinates
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Apply the established pairwise RoPE correction to VLA-JEPA's training-only world predictor.
selected.summary_zh: 将已有的成对 RoPE 修正应用到 VLA-JEPA 训练期世界预测器，恢复相邻坐标的频率配对。
selected.technical_value: Rotary position geometry; norm, inner-product and relative-position invariants; single-frequency broadcasting.
selected.limitations: Correction originated in echosprint's V-JEPA 2 PR #15; not an original algorithm. Training-only predictor, checkpoint outputs/losses change; no pretrained-quality or real-robot performance claim.

selected.title: fix(artifacts): complete positional ZIP reads
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Complete short positional ZIP reads and report premature EOF as an integrity failure.
selected.summary_zh: 补全 ZIP 定位读取中的短读，提前遇到 EOF 时明确报告完整性错误，并保留读取预算。
selected.technical_value: Low-level I/O correctness; offset loop, truncation handling and bounded archive extraction regressions.
selected.limitations: No general throughput or full-platform qualification claim; tests inject short reads on real descriptors.

selected.title: fix: keep pipeline snapshots reusable after resume
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Isolate resumed execution counters so pipeline snapshots remain reusable after retries and breakpoints.
selected.summary_zh: 隔离恢复执行时的访问计数，避免重试和断点执行污染原始 PipelineSnapshot。
selected.technical_value: Checkpoint state ownership, replay determinism, downstream-failure retry and prior-snapshot isolation.
selected.limitations: Focused pipeline checks only; no claim of full repository/integration suite validation.
